---
name: Feature Request / Suggestion
about: Suggest a new optimization routine, UI feature, or performance enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "proposal"]
assignees: ""
---

### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the suggested feature or optimization enhancement.

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when my game textures stutter after driver updates...*).

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or mechanism you would like to see implemented (e.g., Win32 API, specific game priority profiles, UI theme, scheduling daemon options).

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

### Target Hardware / Device Scope
* [ ] Low-End / Potato PC (<= 4GB RAM)
* [ ] Mid-Range Workstation (8GB - 16GB RAM)
* [ ] High-End Competitive Gaming Rig (32GB+ RAM)
* [ ] Cross-Platform (Linux / macOS)

### Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or reference documentation here.
